title: Makai Lemon knows he has "lots to improve" after minus-5 yards in his first NFL game

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Makai Lemon knows he has "lots to improve" after minus-5 yards in his first NFL game
sources.description: Eagles rookie wide receiver Makai Lemon had a box score to forget in the first game of his NFL career: Against the Commanders, Lemon caught three passes for minus-5 yards.
